verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.openai.com (HTTP 200) and Markdown versions of the docs pages, such as codex/skills.md, which point to an llms.txt index. There is also a plugins-specific llms.txt at developers.openai.com/plugins/llms.txt indexing MCP, webhook and checkout docs, and the docs are served as .md URLs agents can fetch directly. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of an agent actually consuming these docs to complete a plugin-building task, and no first-party guidance on pointing an agent at llms.txt.
